parcelFilings.title: SCI du Château de Vosne-Romanée: 1967 contribution of AN 74
parcelFilings.finding: The company’s statutes, updated in 1998 and filed at its 2002 registration, reproduce the 3 July 1967 contribution of Vosne-Romanée AN 74, 84 a 52 ca, “La Romanée”, matching today’s area.
parcelFilings.appNote: Contributed in 1967 to the company recorded here (statutes filed 2002; area matches). Historical contribution; actual operation is not stated.

parcelFilings.title: GFV du Château de Vosne-Romanée: 2021 lease schedule of AN 74

tenants: a partner of the GFV, personally
leaseEvidence.limitation: Scheduled with AN 74 in the 2021 deed; 18 years to 1 November 2019, tacitly renewable by nine-year periods. The deed warrants the leases valid on 14 April 2021; the lease deed itself is not filed.

The deed states that the tenant in place makes the leased land, except that added in 2005, available to this company with the lessor’s authorisation, and that rents are paid by the tenant or this company. A dated recital, not a verified current farming season; flagged for #364.

parcelFilings.finding: The 14 April 2021 deed schedules AN 74, La Romanée, 84 a 52 ca, under the 8 November 2001 métayage to a partner, tacitly renewable, and states that the leased land is made available to SCEA Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair (429010846) with the lessor’s authorisation. Area matches.
parcelFilings.appNote: A 2021 deed lists this parcel (area matches) under a 2001 métayage to a partner, tacitly renewable, and says the land is made available to Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair. Dated 2021; current operation is not verified.

producerHoldings.finding: Undated climat page gives La Romanée, monopole, 0.8452 ha, equal to AN 74’s cadastral area; the history page says the domaine took it into operation in 2002. Undated producer publication: census evidence only, not a verified farming season.

accessGaps: Bounded filing review: 17 filings (518 pages) were screened — 13 of the 13 filings the free index lists for the GFV and 4 of the 9 for the SCEA. Unscreened filings are a bounded negative.

`U14132333` is matched to RCS 408280667 by the rights file’s name, the company’s 2002 registration filing (whose statutes contribute AN 74 with its exact area) and the 2003 renaming deed; the 2019 MAJIC code PBCLPZ stays an unprovable identifier change in the rights file.

The 2001 métayage over AN 74 is held by a partner personally; the 2021 deed states it is tacitly renewed and valid and that the land is made available to SCEA Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair. That dated recital (14 April 2021) is flagged for #364 as a candidate verified-operator record; it is not a current farming season, and verified farming stays 0. The lease deed and any later change are unreviewed.
CLB Participations was GFV co-manager from 3 May 2019 until its resignation from 4 June 2023; today the two companies share family partners and their seat, not a manager.
The domaine’s pages are undated producer publications. They give La Romanée’s area and a 2002 start of operation; they stay census evidence.
